description: This file contains a suite of UI view hierarchy tests for a SwiftUI application, validating the construction and rendering of various views within the app, including status indicators, settings tabs, root navigation, voice settings, chat sheets, and toast notifications.

classes.name: SwiftUIRenderSmokeTests
classes.description: A test suite struct that includes multiple test methods to verify the UI view construction and hierarchy within the app.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Creates a UIWindow, sets the provided SwiftUI view as the root view controller, makes the window key and visible, and performs layout updates.

methods.name: statusPillConnectingBuildsAViewHierarchy
methods.description: Tests that a StatusPill with the 'connecting' gateway builds its view hierarchy correctly.

methods.name: statusPillDisconnectedBuildsAViewHierarchy
methods.description: Tests that a StatusPill with the 'disconnected' gateway builds its view hierarchy correctly.

methods.name: settingsTabBuildsAViewHierarchy
methods.description: Tests the construction of the SettingsTab view within the app's environment.

methods.name: rootTabsBuildAViewHierarchy
methods.description: Tests the assembly of the RootTabs view with environment objects.

methods.name: voiceTabBuildsAViewHierarchy
methods.description: Verifies the VoiceTab view hierarchy construction.

methods.name: voiceWakeWordsViewBuildsAViewHierarchy
methods.description: Tests the VoiceWakeWordsSettingsView within a NavigationStack.

methods.name: chatSheetBuildsAViewHierarchy
methods.description: Builds a ChatSheet view with a GatewayNodeSession and validates its hierarchy.

methods.name: voiceWakeToastBuildsAViewHierarchy
methods.description: Builds a VoiceWakeToast view with a command and checks hierarchy.
